maestras_post_sentinel: Sentinel Maestra. The post has my name on it and precious little else - we are in the north-west of Ashenvale, with the coast behind us and the Ragged Highlands away to the east. The furbolg up there used to leave us be. Something has turned them, and I mean to find out what.
warsong_foreman: Axes up, you lot! ... Oh. You are not one of mine. Gruzak, foreman. This is the Warsong Lumber Camp, the north-west of the eastern woods, and Splintertree is south-east of us. Well, do not just stand there. There is wood to cut and something in the stand that objects.
raynewood_warden: Warden Aelyndra. Quiet, please. This is Raynewood Retreat, in the south-west of the eastern woods, and it is a place for grief. You are not the first to bring noise into it. If you mean to help, lower your voice and I will tell you how.
